# Release notes

The newest release is first. In Odoo the version number starts with the Odoo version, so release 1.1.0 for Odoo 20.0 shows as `20.0.1.1.0`.

## 1.0.1

*2026-11-03, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- New menu Online Stores > WooCommerce Guide opens this user guide.
- The Connection tab of a store links to the setup guide.

## 1.0.0

*2026-11-03, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- First release.
- Orders, customers and refunds from WooCommerce, with webhooks and a 15-minute check.
- Stock, prices, deliveries with tracking, cancellations and credit notes from Odoo to the store.
- Products and variants in both directions, job queue with retry, protection of test databases.
